lines: The chef gave in to the judges' demands.

Reduza o sal, aconselhou o jurado.
Cooks submit to the judges' verdict.
Os cozinheiros se submetem ao veredito dos jurados.
Iron Chef pits two chefs against each other in a themed battle.
